name: grip-success-gate-11d
status: Temporary Grip success Visual Gate (ACTION-11D). Shown while grappled (visual pose 'grapple' or 'drive'), the same pose for neutral and Morozashi. Not Product art until the User Visual Gate accepts it; the Grip attempt pose (ACTION-11A) is separate and unchanged.
note: One authored red Grip success pose is the only source. It is normalized like the accepted idle red (one whole-sprite rotation so FRONT = local +X, explicit root, body core = 2R, exact /4 downscale). Blue reuses the accepted red -> blue rule of runtime_wrestler_recipe.json (single owner): local-Y reflection ((x, y) -> (x, H - y)) + mawashi-only recolor. The reflected blue is intended to face the red as a mirrored grappling pair.

measurement.method: Same landmark registration as the Product Tsuppari / Counter and Grip attempt poses (measure_tsuppari_pose.measure_landmarks / normalization, run once for this candidate): hair blob and mawashi centroids at 1/2 BOX scale registered to the accepted idle red master; rotation delta = angle(H -> B) - idle angle(H -> B); scale s = mean(sqrt(hair area ratio), sqrt(mawashi area ratio)); idle root / body core carried by s * Rot(delta) about the H/B midpoint; source_front_deg = idle 160.7 + delta. Recorded values rounded: front 0.1 deg, points 1 px.

measurement_evidence.candidate: ACTION-11D User-provided Grip success pose (head turned in profile toward the front, arms wrapped forward out of view, gripping the opponent).
measurement_evidence.note: Drawn ~1.40x larger than the idle source at nearly the idle orientation (hair sqrt ratio 1.371, mawashi 1.431, H -> B distance ratio 1.374); s is their area-ratio mean.

skin_tone_match.note: ACTION-11H Visual Gate: deterministic skin-only tone match of the normalized red runtime toward the accepted idle red runtime, applied before the red -> blue derivation (blue inherits the corrected skin). Only RGB of skin-mask pixels changes; alpha, geometry and every other pixel are untouched. No AI regeneration; the input.local source is not edited.
skin_tone_match.luminance: relative luminance Y = 0.2126 R + 0.7152 G + 0.0722 B of linear-light sRGB

mask.note: Runtime-resolution skin candidates: interior alpha, outside the accepted mawashi mask (runtime_wrestler_recipe.json rule), skin hue band with saturation / value floors (drops hair, outline, the white hair tie and white highlights).

skin_tone_match.method: Candidate C (levels): monotonic piecewise-linear curve on skin Y through (0, 0), the uncorrected skin P20 / P50 / P80 -> the idle skin P20 / P50 / P80, and (1, 1); each pixel's linear RGB is scaled by Y' / Y (chromaticity kept), clipped at 1, re-encoded to 8-bit sRGB.

measurement_evidence.note: Skin Y quantiles (P20 / P50 / P80) on the mask above: idle red runtime vs the uncorrected normalized Grip success red.

mask_limits.note: Validation of the accepted hue-band + largest-component mawashi mask at runtime scale (fail closed). Same limits as idle / Tsuppari / Grip attempt (no Grip-success-specific allowance).
